rules.description: Retention period numeric value must align with canonical
rules.messageTemplate: Retention period mismatch: canonical specifies {{canonicalValue}} days but row indicates {{rowValue}} days
rules.resolutionGuidance: Use the exact retention period from the canonical policy, or request a policy update if changed.

rules.description: Customer data retention must be mentioned
rules.messageTemplate: Customer data retention not mentioned: canonical covers customer data but row does not specify
rules.resolutionGuidance: Explicitly mention customer data in the retention policy description.

rules.description: Deletion process description should contain key elements from canonical
rules.messageTemplate: Deletion process description missing key elements from canonical policy
rules.resolutionGuidance: Include the key deletion workflow steps from the canonical policy.

rules.description: Indefinite retention should not be claimed if canonical specifies limits
rules.messageTemplate: Indefinite retention claimed: canonical specifies time-limited retention but row claims indefinite storage
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove indefinite retention claims and align with canonical time-limited policy.
